national_news.title: India and China Discuss LAC Understanding and Border Management
bullets: The Ministry of External Affairs (MEA) stated that India and China utilize existing diplomatic and military mechanisms to resolve issues along the Line of Actual Control (LAC).
Both sides agreed to discuss ways to improve understanding of the LAC in appropriate areas for better border management, emphasizing that peace and tranquillity are essential for bilateral relations.
The MEA highlighted ongoing humanitarian efforts, including communication with Iran to facilitate the transport of life-saving medicines and ensuring the safety of Indian nationals abroad.

national_news.title: President Droupadi Murmu Attends Bastar Dussehra Festival 2026
bullets: President Droupadi Murmu stated that Chhattisgarh has been freed from Naxalism through the combined efforts of the central and state governments.
She addressed the 'Bastar Dussehra Festival 2026' at Lalbag Maidan in Jagdalpur and highlighted initiatives to provide financial facilities to tribal entrepreneurs.
The President praised the traditional Muria Darbar as a reflection of democratic values where local communities present their grievances to leaders.

national_news.title: Prime Minister Congratulates Indian Para-Athletes at Asian Para Games
bullets: Prime Minister Narendra Modi congratulated Indian para-athletes for their remarkable medal-winning performances at the Asian Para Games.
Key medalists praised include Thulasimathi Murugesan (Silver), Harvinder Singh and Vijay Sundi (Gold), Nitesh Kumar (Gold), and Pramod Bhagat (Silver).
Sandeep Kumar won Gold in the Men's 400m T64 event with a new World Record, marking India's 100th medal at the Games.
national_news.exam_tag: SSC CGL / UPSC - Sports Current Affairs

national_news.title: India Exercises Right of Reply Against Pakistan at the United Nations
bullets: India criticized Pakistan at the UN over remarks on religious freedom and burial rights during discussions on an interim report by the UN Special Rapporteur.
First Secretary Bhavika Mangalanandan recalled Pakistan's historical refusal to acknowledge the bodies of its soldiers killed in the 1999 Kargil War.
India highlighted that the Indian Army had buried Pakistani soldiers with military honors according to Islamic rites, while criticizing Pakistan's treatment of minorities.

national_news.title: Prime Minister Modi Inaugurates Chinmaya Amrit Mahotsav Global Sammelan in New Delhi
bullets: PM Narendra Modi inaugurated the Chinmaya Amrit Mahotsav Global Sammelan at Bharat Mandapam, New Delhi, marking 75 years of the Chinmaya Mission.
Stressed the vision of building a developed India by 2047, uniting society against divisive forces, and promoting self-reliance.
Highlighted that over 650 stolen ancient idols and antiquities have been successfully brought back to India from abroad over the past 12 years.

national_news.title: Satellite-Tagged Amur Falcons 'Apapang' and 'Alang' Return to Manipur
bullets: Satellite-tagged Amur Falcons Apapang and Alang returned to Manipur after migrating across 23 countries in Asia and Africa.
The birds were tagged by the Wildlife Institute of India in November 2025 and returned 11 days after leaving breeding grounds in northeastern China.
The falcons will temporarily stay in Manipur's Tamenglong district to feed and build fat reserves before undertaking a non-stop flight to Somalia across the Arabian Sea.

national_news.title: CAQM Reviews Paddy Stubble Management Measures in Punjab
bullets: The Commission for Air Quality Management (CAQM) reviewed in-situ and ex-situ paddy straw management measures in Ropar, Hoshiyarpur, and Amritsar districts of Punjab.
CAQM directed state authorities to achieve co-firing targets in thermal power plants and ensure timely availability of Crop Residue Management (CRM) machinery to farmers.
The review aims to minimize stubble burning incidents and enforce emission norms during the paddy harvesting season.

national_news.title: Rajnath Singh Addresses Army Commanders' Conference, Releases Land Warfare Doctrine
bullets: Defence Minister Rajnath Singh addressed the Army Commanders' Conference in New Delhi, urging a 20-30 year strategic vision and dynamic preparedness.
In FY 2025-26, India's defence production reached a record Rs 1.78 lakh crore, while defence exports touched approximately Rs 38,000 crore.
The Defence Minister released the new Land Warfare Doctrine and emphasized integration across air, maritime, space, and cyber domains.

national_news.title: India's Data Centre Sector Growth and Sustainable Cooling Technologies
bullets: India's data centre investments are projected to surge from ₹0.36 trillion in FY26 to ₹1.31 trillion by FY32, supported by a 20-year tax horizon extending to 2047.
Total data centre capacity is projected to grow from 1,575 MW in CY26 to 8,000 MW by CY30, driven largely by AI workloads and cloud services.
Electricity demand from data centres is estimated to reach 17 GW by 2031-32, prompting exploration of energy-efficient solutions like seawater cooling and direct-to-chip liquid cooling.

national_news.title: C-DAC and Bank of India Partner to Develop Indigenous Quantum Technologies for Banking
bullets: The Centre for Development of Advanced Computing (C-DAC) and Bank of India (BOI) signed an MoU to explore indigenous quantum technologies for the banking sector.
The partnership aims to build a Quantum Ecosystem for Financial Innovation to enhance cybersecurity, operational resilience, and decision-making.
The collaboration will also focus on AI-driven fraud detection, intelligent document processing, and advanced capacity-building training programs in quantum computing.

national_news.title: DDWS Organises Virtual Conference on Jal Jeevan Mission 2.0 and Finance Commission Convergence
bullets: The Department of Drinking Water and Sanitation (DDWS), Ministry of Jal Shakti, organized a virtual conference focusing on convergence between Jal Jeevan Mission (JJM) 2.0 and the 16th Finance Commission.
Discussions centered on source sustainability, water security, and Gram Panchayat-led planning for sustainable rural drinking water service delivery under the 73rd Constitutional Amendment.

Secretary Ashok K.K. Meena emphasized shifting focus from mere infrastructure creation to functionality, O&M (Operation and Maintenance), and effective utilization of tied grants for water and sanitation.

national_news.title: India Counters Pakistan's Claims on Religious Freedom at UN
bullets: First Secretary at India's Permanent Mission to the UN, Bhavika Mangalanandan, addressed the UN discussion on an interim report by UN Special Rapporteur Nazila Ghanea.

India highlighted the declining population and rights violations of religious minorities in Pakistan while recalling that India buried Pakistani soldiers from the 1999 Kargil War with full military honours and Islamic rites.
India questioned the UN report's focus on the burial rights of terrorists, urging due consideration for the rights of victims of terrorism.
national_news.exam_tag: UPSC / SSC / State PSC International Relations

national_news.title: India and Uzbekistan Hold 10th Joint Working Group Meeting on Counter Terrorism
bullets: The 10th meeting of the India-Uzbekistan Joint Working Group on Counter Terrorism was held in New Delhi.
Discussions focused on countering extremism, radicalization, terror financing, misuse of technology, and transnational organized crime.
Both nations reaffirmed their commitment to cooperate in multilateral forums including the UN, SCO-RATS, and EAG.

national_news.title: India and Poland Agree to Double Bilateral Trade by 2030 and Enhance Strategic Ties
bullets: Prime Minister Narendra Modi held bilateral talks with Polish Prime Minister Donald Tusk in New Delhi, setting a target to double bilateral trade by 2030.
Both leaders agreed to boost strategic cooperation in critical and emerging technologies, defense innovation, cybersecurity, semiconductors, rare earth minerals, and nuclear energy.
India invited Poland to join the Indo-Pacific Oceans Initiative (IPOI) to promote peace, freedom of navigation, and sustainable development in the region.
national_news.exam_tag: UPSC GS Paper II / IR / SSC

national_news.title: Sheetal Devi and Toman Kumar Win Compound Mixed Team Gold in Aichi-Nagoya
bullets: Sheetal Devi and Toman Kumar clinched the compound mixed team archery gold at the Asian Para Games in Aichi-Nagoya, defeating Indonesia 151-148 in the final.
The top-seeded Indian pair set a new World Record in the qualification round before claiming the gold medal.
Suvarna Raj won Gold in the women’s F-54 discus throw event, while Swati Chaudhary secured Silver in the women’s W-1 archery event.
national_news.exam_tag: Asian Para Games 2026 / World Records in Sports

national_news.title: MEA Facilitates Return of Stranded Umrah Pilgrims from Saudi Arabia
bullets: Over 3,000 stranded Umrah pilgrims returned from Saudi Arabia to India over a week, alongside 10,000 normal pilgrims on available flights.
Indian Embassy in Riyadh and Consulate in Jeddah established 24x7 control rooms and are actively assisting affected citizens.
Major Indian carriers suspended services to Saudi Arabia temporarily, while alternative options via Saudia and Flynas remain operational.

national_news.title: India and Poland Agree to Boost Cooperation in Defence, Space, and Nuclear Energy
bullets: Prime Minister Narendra Modi and Polish Prime Minister Donald Tusk held comprehensive discussions in New Delhi, agreeing to double bilateral trade by 2030.
Both leaders condemned terrorism in all forms, including cross-border terrorism, and called for dismantling terrorist safe havens and financing networks.
India invited Poland to join the Indo-Pacific Oceans Initiative, expanding strategic cooperation into critical technologies, semiconductors, and rare earth minerals.

bihar_news.title: CtrlS Plans ₹10,000 Crore AI Factory in Bihar and Opens Patna Data Centre
bullets: CtrlS Datacenters signed a letter of intent with the Bihar government to invest ₹10,000 crore for a 150 MW hyperscale AI factory in Bodh Gaya.
The company inaugurated a ₹400 crore data centre in the Patliputra Industrial Area, Patna, with an initial IT load capacity of 12 MW.
The initiatives form part of CtrlS's broader expansion strategy to establish over 20 edge data centres across Tier 2 and Tier 3 cities.

bihar_news.title: ICAR–MGIFRI Motihari Participates in National Launch of Khet Bachao Abhiyan - Rabi 2026
bullets: ICAR–Mahatma Gandhi Integrated Farming Research Institute (MGIFRI), Motihari, participated in the national launch of Khet Bachao Abhiyan (KBA) – Rabi 2026.
The campaign focuses on balanced fertilizer use, soil health improvement, natural farming, crop diversification, and prevention of stubble burning.
Six multidisciplinary scientific teams were formed to conduct village-level awareness programs and farmer interactions from October 22 to November 30, 2026.

bihar_news.title: Bihar Government Plans to Develop Jamui's Kukurjhap Dam as Eco-Tourism Hub
bullets: The Bihar government plans to develop Kukurjhap Dam located in Barhat block of Jamui district into an eco-tourism hub under the Public-Private Partnership (PPP) model.
The project is being overseen by the Bihar State Eco-Tourism Development Society as part of the Unified Eco-Tourism Master Plan.
The master plan covers 7 ecologically rich districts including Jamui, Rohtas, Kaimur, Banka, Nawada, and West Champaran.

bihar_news.title: Biennial Elections Held for Eight Bihar Legislative Council Seats
bullets: Polling held for eight Bihar Legislative Council (MLC) seats comprising four Graduates' and four Teachers' constituencies.
A total of 5.32 lakh eligible voters decided the fate of 150 candidates across 933 polling stations, with counting scheduled for October 27.
Saran Teachers' constituency recorded the highest turnout at 13.56% in the initial hours, and key issues included financial recognition and pay scales for teachers in unaided schools.
